strings.name: no_data_vow_blood_oxygen
strings.value:
"Blood oxygen level is the amount of oxygen circulating in the blood. Most of the oxygen is carried by red blood cells, which collect oxygen from the lungs and deliver it to all parts of the body. 

Last night's recovery is required to present this data. If you have a recovery for last night your account may have experienced a processing error."

strings.name: no_data_vow_hrv
strings.value:
"Heart rate variability is the variance in time between the beats of your heart. HRV is a great indicator of how well your body can adapt to its environment and perform at its best. 

Last night's recovery is required to present this data. If you have a recovery for last night your account may have experienced a processing error."

strings.name: no_data_vow_resp_rate
strings.value:
"Your respiratory rate, often referred to as your breathing rate, is the number of breaths you take per minute. 

Last night's recovery is required to present this data. If you have a recovery for last night your account may have experienced a processing error."

strings.name: no_data_vow_rhr
strings.value:
"Resting heart rate (RHR) is how often your heart beats while at rest. Short-term increases in RHR can indicate fatigue, while long-term decreases signal improved cardiovascular health. 

Last night's recovery is required to present this data. If you have a recovery for last night your account may have experienced a processing error."

strings.name: no_data_vow_skin_temp
strings.value:
"Skin temperature differs slightly from core body temperature. Core body temperature is the metric with which you're most likely familiar and it's the measure of your internal body temperature that can be taken with an oral thermometer. Skin temperature, however, is the measure of your external body temperature that we can measure with your WHOOP device. 

Last night's recovery is required to present this data. If you have a recovery for last night your account may have experienced a processing error."
